messages:
liam (sec-eng): FYI found an old partner upload that contains a Vault-wrapped ciphertext blob for svcacct `partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. bucket was public for ~10h. tagging @sophia @ania for rotation plan

sophia (infra): ack. which Vault path and KMS key are we talking about?

liam (sec-eng): path: secret/data/partners/acme/stripe. wrap kms: projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-old. blob file: gs://partner-uploads/2026-03-22/ingest-blob.enc

ania (platform): is the blob definitely transit-encrypted vs raw secret? if it's transit-ciphertext we can rewrap without ever seeing plaintext.

liam (sec-eng): looks like transit format (starts with vault:v1:). still treat as high since object was public. plan = 1) revoke partner SA, 2) provision new KMS key under our control, 3) rewrap via Vault transit to new key, 4) rotate credentials behind the secret.

tara (oncall): agree. also need audit retention bump for acme-prod logs and to snapshot Vault before any writes. I'll create INC-2026 and schedule 20m window at 18:30 PT.

ania (platform): rewrap approach: use vault's rewrap endpoint to avoid exposing plaintext. pseudocode:

```bash
# dry-run: fetch ciphertext and do rewrap to temp path
C=$(vault kv get -field=ciphertext secret/partners/acme/stripe)
NEW_C=$(vault write -field=ciphertext transit/rewrap key=new-partner-wrap ciphertext=$C)
vault kv put secret/temp/partners/acme/stripe ciphertext=$NEW_C
```

ania (platform): do the dry-run first and diff metadata timestamps. if OK, swap into prod path. will also add a check to call the downstream service to ensure auth succeeds after rotate.

liam (sec-eng): important: the partner's CI identity may have uploaded logs that contain tokens. I'll grep the 12h window for `Authorization:` in the bucket and request partner to rotate any creds they control.

sophia (infra): i'll disable the partner SA binding now (short maintenance) and add a tf change to remove the binding. command: `gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member=serviceAccount:partner-ci@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026 created by tara (oncall). Severity: medium. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

liam (sec-eng): validation checks for post-rewrap: 1) vault audit logs show rewrap write for path, 2) downstream token acceptance test passes, 3) no unexpected errors in service logs for 15m.

ania (platform): also update KMS key IAM so only vault SA can use new-partner-wrap and set key rotation policy to 90d after stable. For HSM-backed keys we need to request approval; using software key for now to speed up.

sophia (infra): snapshot commands: `vault snapshot save /tmp/pre-rewrap-$(date +%s).snap` and `gcloud kms keys versions create --key new-partner-wrap --protection-level=software` (if needed).

liam (sec-eng): rollback plan: restore snapshot and reapply old IAM bindings if we disabled partner SA early. ensure we keep a copy of original ciphertext artifacts under a locked GCS bucket for forensics.

tara (oncall): i'm on-call at go-time. will set a heartbeat in INC-2026 and page infra if error rate >3% for 5m. Posting timeline + checklist in the incident thread in 10m. :white_check_mark:

ania (platform): I'll run the dry-run in staging at 18:00 PT, push PR for KMS IAM + logging retention change (increase acme-prod logs to 90d), and share the rewrap runbook link.

liam (sec-eng): pls also rotate any long-lived service tokens that are referenced by the partner job in our codebase. i'll search for `partner-ingest` in repo history and create tasks.

sophia (infra): completed removal of the partner binding (temporary) and created a tf patch to remove it permanently pending legal. pushed logs to INC-2026.

inc-bot: automated alert - IAM change detected for service account partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-23T17:02:10Z. Reference INC-2026.

liam (sec-eng): thanks everyone. after dry-run we'll reconvene in the incident thread and proceed to rewrap + rotate keys. will loop in legal for partner notification.
